$comment: Canonical launch-ticket contract (DESIGN.md 3.2, SEC-DESIGN.md 1.3-1.5). Owned by lane contracts; byte-identical copies in dms-api tests/Fixtures/formplus, classic src/contracts/formplus and dms-ui lib/__fixtures__/formplus (tools/contracts.manifest). Every case is {name, input, expect:{valid, status?, code?}}: `valid` is whether input passes the schema it is listed under; `status`/`code` is the HTTP outcome. Cases with `requires: "server"` need the tenant database (membership, rights, ticket store) and are replayed only by the dms-api tests; every other case is pure and is replayed by each repo's own parser. All tickets, credentials and verifiers below are made-up samples.

issuance.name: unknown-key-tenant-id
issuance.why: strict body: tenant and workspace come from the credential, never the caller (SD-02)

issuance.name: master-edit-with-seed
issuance.why: master is only for a create (SEC 1.4)

issuance.name: return-url-foreign-origin
issuance.why: shape is fine; the server checks origin against formplus.launch.allowed_origins

issuance.name: bearer-with-scopes
issuance.why: a scoped (connect) token may not mint a ticket (L7)

issuance.name: outsider-not-a-member
issuance.why: valid token and rights, not in the workspace (T-DMSINT-02)

issuance.name: editor-master-in-other-folder
issuance.why: M_f2 is mapped to a folder the editor cannot see: no existence oracle (T-DMSINT-03)

exchangeOutcomes.name: replay
exchangeOutcomes.why: every failure of the exchange answers the same body (SEC 1.5): no oracle for which check failed

exchangeOutcomes.name: expired
exchangeOutcomes.why: every failure of the exchange answers the same body (SEC 1.5): no oracle for which check failed
